DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 母の相談予約で来ました。母は少し遅れます。私の名前で受付を始められますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 母名義の相談予約へ本人遅着中に家族名義受付できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm here for my mother's consultation appointment. She'll be a little late. Can you start checking us in under my name?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a family member can check in under their own name for a consultation booked in their mother's name while she is running late. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約はお母様の名義ですね。相談を受ける方もお母様ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The appointment is in your mother's name, correct? Is she also the person receiving the consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。私は説明を聞く手伝いです。予約名だけ私に変えればよいと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 相談対象は母で本人は説明補助と予約名変更の誤解を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I'm here to help her listen to the explanation. I thought we only needed to change the booking name to mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your mother is receiving the consultation, you are helping with the explanation, and you misunderstood about changing the booking name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 名義を変える前に担当へ確認しましょう。お母様がまだ到着していないことを伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check with the person in charge before changing the name. I'll tell them your mother hasn't arrived yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 母の予約のまま、遅れる連絡をお願いします。私は本人の代わりに同意するつもりではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予約名義を保持し本人遅着連絡を依頼して代理同意ではないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please keep the appointment in my mother's name and let them know she'll be late. I don't intend to give consent on her behalf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to keep the booking in your mother's name and report her late arrival, and explain that you are not giving consent on her behalf. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 付き添いの役割も伝えます。到着の見込みは分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll also explain your role as her accompanying family member. Do you know when she expects to arrive?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: あと十五分ほどです。母が来るまでは、自分の相談として話を進めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 母到着十五分予定で家族自身の相談に切替えないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: In about fifteen minutes. Until she arrives, I won't proceed as though this were my own consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer that your mother will arrive in about fifteen minutes and that you won't switch to a consultation for yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が待機や再調整の方法をご案内します。こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will explain whether to wait or reschedule. Please wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予約対象は母で、私は付き添いです。十五分遅れることと合わせて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 母本人対象と付き添い役割及び遅着時間をまとめて伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: My mother is the person the appointment is for, and I'm accompanying her. I'll explain that along with her being fifteen minutes late.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain together that the consultation is for your mother, that you are accompanying her, and how late she will be. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へお知らせします。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll notify the person in charge. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かご質問がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Do you have any questions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 検査前の説明で全部という言葉が聞こえました。何を外すのか、もう一度教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 検査服装説明の全部という一語の対象を聞き返す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I heard the word 'everything' in the explanation before the examination. Could you tell me again what I need to remove?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask what the single word 'everything' referred to in the clothing instructions for the examination. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 検査の案内を確認します。服装についての説明が聞き取れなかったのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the examination instructions. You couldn't make out the explanation about clothing, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。上着のことか、身に付けた物全部なのか分かりません。まだ着替えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 上着か身付け物全体か不明で未更衣と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I don't know whether it meant my jacket or everything I'm wearing. I haven't changed yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you are unsure whether it meant your jacket or everything you are wearing and that you haven't changed yet. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 対象を一つずつ説明します。分からないまま外さず、案内された更衣場所を使ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll explain each item. Don't remove things while you're unsure, and use the changing area you are directed to.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: どの服を残し、何を外すか順に聞きたいです。人のいる廊下では着替えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 残す服外す物を順に説明依頼し廊下で更衣しないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to hear, in order, which clothes to keep on and what to remove. I won't change in a corridor where other people are present.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request a step-by-step explanation of what to keep on and remove, and say you won't change in the corridor. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 更衣室で、この検査に必要な服装を確認します。外した物は袋へまとめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll confirm the clothing required for this examination in the changing room. Put the things you remove together in a bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 検査着に替える時も、説明された範囲だけにします。袋へ入れた物の置き場も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内範囲のみ更衣し外した物の袋置場を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Even when changing into the examination gown, I'll only change as instructed. Please also tell me where to put the bag containing my things.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will change only to the extent instructed and ask where to put the bag of removed items. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 置き場をご案内します。着替えが終わっても不明な点があればお声かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll show you where to put it. If anything is still unclear after you have changed, please ask.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 服装と置き場を聞き返してから更衣室で準備します。聞こえた一語だけで判断しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 服装置場再説明後に更衣室で準備すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask again about the clothing and storage location, then prepare in the changing room. I won't decide based on just one word I heard.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will prepare in the changing room after asking for the clothing and storage instructions again. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。更衣室へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll show you to the changing room.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 停めた車に傷がありました。近くの店にカメラがあります。自分で映像をもらう前に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 駐車車両傷と近隣カメラ存在を伝え映像取得前に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found a scratch on my parked car. A nearby shop has a camera. I'd like to ask for advice before trying to get the footage myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the scratch on your parked car and the nearby camera, and ask for advice before obtaining footage. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 傷に気づいた時刻と、最後に傷がなかった時刻を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me when you noticed the scratch and the last time you know it wasn't there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 朝九時にはなく、昼十二時に見つけました。店の前を通った人が原因とはまだ分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 傷なし九時発見十二時と通行人原因未確認を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It wasn't there at nine in the morning, and I found it at noon. I don't yet know whether someone walking past the shop caused it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that there was no scratch at nine, you found it at twelve, and a passerby's involvement is unconfirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、確認した事実と推測を分けましょう。お店には何を伝えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, let's separate confirmed facts from assumptions. What did you tell the shop?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 傷が見つかったことだけ伝えました。映像のコピーや、映った人の名前は要求していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 店へ傷のみ伝え映像コピー人物名未要求と報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I only told them I'd found a scratch. I haven't asked for a copy of the footage or the names of people shown in it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report that you only told the shop about the scratch and haven't requested footage copies or people's names. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 映像の扱いは店と確認が必要です。こちらで相談を進め、必要な確認方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: How the footage is handled needs to be checked with the shop. We'll discuss the matter here and explain the necessary way to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 店の場所とカメラの向きを地図で示します。知らない人の写真をネットへ出すこともしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: カメラ位置方向を示し人物写真をネット公開しないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll show you the shop's location and the direction the camera faces on a map. I also won't post pictures of strangers online.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the camera's location and direction and say you won't publish people's photos online. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その情報を伺います。ご自身で原因を決めず、状況を順番に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll take that information. Let's check the circumstances in order without deciding the cause yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 午前九時から十二時の間に傷が見つかったことと、店のカメラの場所を報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 傷確認時間帯とカメラ所在を事実として報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll report that the scratch was discovered within the period from nine in the morning to twelve, and where the shop's camera is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report the time window for the scratch and the camera's location as facts. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。詳しく伺います。ご相談ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll ask you for the details. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 往復はがきを送りたいのですが、返信の方にも相手の住所を書きました。直し方を相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 往復はがき返信側へ相手住所を記入した修正方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to send a reply-paid postcard, but I wrote the recipient's address on the reply half too. Could you advise me how to correct it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to correct the recipient's address mistakenly written on the reply half of a reply-paid postcard. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 返信を受け取るのはお客様ですね。いまは両方が相手宛てになっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: You'll be receiving the reply, correct? Are both halves currently addressed to the other person?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。相手が返す方も、相手の住所を書くと思いました。まだ出していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 両宛先相手住所で未投函と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I thought the half they send back should have their address too. I haven't posted it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that both halves bear the other person's address and the postcard hasn't been posted. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 返信側の宛先は受け取るお客様の住所です。読めるように書き直せるか確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The reply half should be addressed to you, the person receiving it. Let's check whether you can rewrite it legibly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: どの面が返信側か見てもらえますか。往信側の正しい宛先まで消さないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 返信面の識別を頼み正しい往信宛先は消さないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Could you check which side is the reply half? I want to avoid erasing the correct address on the outgoing half too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask them to identify the reply side and say you don't want to erase the correct outgoing address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この面が返信側です。相手への往信面と混同しないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: This is the reply side. Please don't confuse it with the outgoing side addressed to the other person.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 返信側だけ自分の住所へ直します。返事を書く欄も住所で埋めないよう確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返信のみ本人宛て修正し返事記入欄を住所で埋めないよう確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll change only the reply side to my own address. I'd also like to check so I don't fill the reply-writing space with the address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will correct only the reply address to your own and check that you leave the reply-writing space free of address text. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。住所欄と記入欄を分けてご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please distinguish the address field from the writing field.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 往信は相手宛て、返信は自分宛てに整え、返事を書く欄は空けて差し出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 往信相手宛て返信本人宛て及び返信欄空白で差出すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll address the outgoing half to the other person and the reply half to myself, and send it with the reply-writing space left blank.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will send it with the outgoing half addressed to the other person, the reply half to yourself, and the reply-writing space blank. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。整いましたら受付へお持ちください。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Bring it to the counter when it's ready. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How may I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 貯めた硬貨を口座に入れたいです。金額を数えていないのですが、受付方法を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未計数硬貨を口座へ入金する受付方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to deposit the coins I've saved into my account. I haven't counted the amount. Could you explain how to arrange the deposit?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to deposit uncounted coins into your account. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 硬貨の入金の取扱いを確認します。異物や別の物は混じっていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check how we handle coin deposits. Are there any foreign objects or other things mixed in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 紙のクリップが一つ入っているかもしれません。袋の重さで五千円くらいと思っただけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: クリップ混入可能性と重量から五千円程度と推測しただけと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: There might be one paper clip in there. I only guessed it was about five thousand yen from the bag's weight.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that there may be a paper clip mixed in and that five thousand yen was only an estimate based on weight. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 推測額で申告せず、異物を確認してください。計数や手数料の条件もご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please don't declare an estimated amount; check for foreign objects first. I'll also explain the counting and fee conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: クリップを除いてからお願いします。枚数による手数料があるか、先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 異物除去後の取扱いと枚数手数料を事前に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please handle them after I've removed the clip. I'd like to ask first whether there is a fee based on the number of coins.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about handling the coins after removing the foreign object and about fees based on coin count beforehand. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 対象の枚数と手続き方法で確認します。計数前に条件をご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check based on the number of coins involved and the procedure used. I'll explain the conditions before counting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 費用を聞いてから入金を決めます。五千円というのは確定した金額ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 費用後に入金判断し推測五千円を確定額としないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll decide whether to deposit after hearing the cost. Five thousand yen isn't a confirmed amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will decide on the deposit after hearing the cost and that the estimated five thousand yen is not a confirmed amount. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。処理前にご本人の同意を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We'll confirm your consent before processing them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 異物を除いた硬貨を見てもらい、費用と確認できた金額に納得してから入金を頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 異物除去済硬貨の計数額費用確認後に入金同意すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll have you examine the coins after removing foreign objects, and ask for the deposit only once I'm satisfied with the fee and the verified amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will consent to the deposit after checking the counted amount and fees for coins with foreign objects removed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll direct you to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 予約したケーキを受け取りに来ました。予約票の日付まで食べられる、という意味ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約ケーキ票の日付が食用期限か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm here to collect the cake I reserved. Does the date on the reservation slip mean it can be eaten until then?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the date on the reserved cake's slip is its use-by date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約票の日付は受取の予定日です。商品の期限は別に表示を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The date on the reservation slip is the planned collection date. Let's check the product's separate expiry label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 明後日の集まりで食べたいです。この日付を保存できる最終日と思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 明後日集まり用途と受取日を保存最終日と誤解したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to eat it at a gathering the day after tomorrow. I thought this date was the last day it could be kept.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the cake is for a gathering the day after tomorrow and that you mistook the collection date for the last storage day. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お渡しする商品の期限と保存方法を見てから、その予定に合うかお考えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the expiry date and storage instructions for the product we give you before deciding whether it suits your plans.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 商品の期限を先に見せてください。予約済みでも、明後日まで保つとは決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 商品期限を事前確認し予約を日持ち保証と扱わないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please show me the product's expiry date first. Even though it's reserved, I won't assume it will keep until the day after tomorrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the product's expiry date beforehand and say you won't treat a reservation as a guarantee of how long it keeps. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらのラベルをご覧ください。今回の商品は明後日の予定には合いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please look at this label. This product won't suit your plans for the day after tomorrow.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では予定の人数分を今日買い増すことはやめます。この予約品は今日食べる分として受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予定不適合を受け追加購入をやめ予約品を当日分として受取る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I won't buy extra today for the number of people attending. I'll collect this reserved cake to eat today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Having learned it won't suit your plans, cancel the extra purchase and collect the reserved item for eating today. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。持ち帰りの時間と保存の案内も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Please also check the guidance on transport time and storage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: すぐ家へ運び、商品表示の方法で保管します。受取日と期限は分けて見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 即時持帰り表示保存を守り受取日と期限を分けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take it straight home and store it as directed on the label. I'll distinguish the collection date from the expiry date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will take it home immediately, follow the labeled storage instructions, and distinguish collection and expiry dates. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。お気をつけてお持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please take care carrying it home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人と記念写真を撮りたいです。この案内標識に布を掛けて背景を作ってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 集合写真の背景用に案内標識へ布を掛けてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to take a souvenir photo with my friends. May we drape a cloth over this information sign to make a backdrop?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may hang a cloth over an information sign as a backdrop for a group photo. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 案内が読めなくなるので、標識は覆わないでください。まだ布を掛けていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please don't cover the sign, as people won't be able to read the information. You haven't draped the cloth over it yet, have you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、手に持ったままです。写真の間だけならよいと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未掛布で短時間なら可能と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, I'm still holding it. I thought it would be all right just while we took the photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you haven't hung the cloth and thought it was allowed for a short time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 短時間でも案内を使う方がいます。標識を隠さない位置で撮影してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Even for a short time, people need the information. Please take your photo somewhere that doesn't hide the sign.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 木にも結ばず、布を自分たちで持ちたいです。通路の外で立てる場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 木への結付けもせず手持ち布で通路外撮影場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: We'd like to hold the cloth ourselves without tying it to a tree either. Please show us somewhere we can stand off the walkway.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you won't tie the cloth to a tree either and ask for a place off the walkway to take photos while holding it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの広い場所なら通行の妨げになりにくいです。周囲の方も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: This open area is less likely to obstruct people passing. Please also check for people around you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここで二人が布を持ちます。案内標識と入口が写らなくても、隠すことはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内入口を隠さず指定広場で二人手持ち撮影すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Two of us will hold the cloth here. Even if the information sign and entrance aren't in the photo, we won't cover them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say two people will hold the cloth for the photo in the designated open area without hiding the sign or entrance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。撮影後は布や荷物を残さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please don't leave the cloth or your belongings behind after the photo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 写真のために標識を覆わず、この場所で撮り、布も全て持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 標識未遮蔽で撮影後布荷物全て持帰ると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: We won't cover the sign for the photo. We'll take it here and bring all the cloth home with us.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm you will take the photo without covering the sign and take all cloth and belongings home afterward. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。周囲に気をつけてお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05206-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Enjoy yourselves, and be mindful of those around you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 案内図では右なのにエレベーターが見えません。大きい荷物があるので場所を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 案内図の右に設備が見えず大型荷物で場所確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: The map says right, but I can't see the elevator. I have large luggage, so I'd like to confirm where it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you can't see the facility to the right shown on the map and ask to confirm its location because you have large luggage. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 図の上の印と、今向いている方向を確認しましょう。地図を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the mark at the top of the map and the direction you're facing now. Please show me the map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 紙の文字を逆さに持っていました。右と書いてある方へ進んだつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 紙を逆さに保持し左右だけで進んだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was holding the paper with the writing upside down. I thought I'd headed in the direction marked right.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you held the paper upside down and proceeded based only on left and right. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 紙を回して現在地を合わせます。この売店が目印になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's turn the paper and align it with your current location. This shop will serve as a landmark.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 売店が図のこの位置ですね。自分が向いている方向も合わせてから進みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 売店の図位置と本人方向を一致させたいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: So the shop is here on the map. I'd like to align it with the direction I'm facing too before moving on.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to match the shop's position on the map with the direction you are facing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。左右だけでなく、売店の先にある案内表示を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Besides left and right, check the directional sign beyond the shop.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 荷物を置いたまま先に探しに行かず、持ってゆっくり表示まで進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 荷物を放置せず保持して表示までゆっくり進むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't leave my luggage behind to look ahead. I'll carry it and go slowly as far as the sign.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will keep your luggage with you and proceed slowly to the sign without leaving it unattended. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 出発までの時間に不安があれば、係員へ列車を伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you're worried about the time until departure, tell a staff member which train you're taking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 余裕はあります。地図の向きと現在地を合わせ、売店の先の表示を見て移動します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 時間余裕と図方向現在地を合わせ目印表示で移動すると復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have time to spare. I'll align the map's orientation and my current location, then follow the sign beyond the shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you have enough time and will align the map's direction and current location, using the landmark and sign to move. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。迷ったら近くの係員へお声がけください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. If you get lost, ask a nearby staff member. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 住所の手続きに持ってきた袋に、前の部屋に残っていた他人の通知も入っていました。分けて確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転入書類袋に他人通知混入で分離確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The bag I brought for my address procedure also contained someone else's notice that was left in my previous room. I'd like to separate the papers and check them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to separate and check another person's notice mixed into the bag of documents for your move-in procedure. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人の名前の書類はどれですか。ほかの方の紙は広げずに分けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which documents have your name on them? Please separate the other person's papers without spreading them out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この二枚は私の名前です。もう一枚は前の住人らしいですが、その人とは会っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人名義二枚と未面識別名義一枚を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: These two have my name. The other one seems to belong to the previous resident, but I've never met that person.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the two documents in your name from the one in another name belonging to someone you haven't met. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 名前が違う紙をご本人の申請資料に含めないでください。本人の二枚を担当へ見せましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please don't include papers in a different name in your application documents. Let's show your two papers to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 他人の紙の内容を読み上げず封筒に戻します。私の書類だけで不足があるか見てほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 他人紙を読み上げず封筒へ戻し本人資料不足確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll put the other person's paper back in the envelope without reading its contents aloud. I'd like you to check whether my own documents are sufficient.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Return the other person's paper to the envelope without reading it aloud and request a check for missing documents in your own application. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要資料はご本人の状況を担当が確認します。他人の郵便の扱いは適切な相談先へ聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will check the required documents based on your circumstances. Please ask the appropriate contact how to handle someone else's mail.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その人の代わりに住所変更するのではなく、手元の通知の扱いだけ別に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 他人住所変更代理でなく通知扱いのみ別照会と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll ask separately only about how to handle the notice I have, rather than changing that person's address on their behalf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will separately ask only about handling the notice, not change another person's address as their representative. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。ご自身の申請と他人宛ての物を分けて進めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Let's proceed with your application separately from items addressed to someone else.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 本人の二枚で住所手続きを相談し、他人の紙は申請に使わず別の扱いを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人申請二枚と他人紙処理を分けて進めると復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask about the address procedure using my two documents and separately check how to handle the other person's paper without using it in my application.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will proceed separately with your own two-document application and handling the other person's paper. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当窓口へご案内します。分けてくださりありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll show you to the relevant counter. Thank you for separating them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 電話で聞いた予約変更の候補日を勤務先へ送ろうとしました。まだ確定しているか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 変更候補を勤務先送信前に確定状態を照会する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was about to send my workplace the proposed date for an appointment change I heard over the phone. I'd like to check whether it's confirmed yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check whether the proposed change is confirmed before sending it to your workplace. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 変更完了の連絡は受けましたか。候補日を聞いた時の案内を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you been notified that the change is complete? Please tell me what you were told when they gave you the proposed date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ先生の空きを確認して折り返すと言われました。私は来週火曜が決まったと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同医師空き折返し待ちなのに火曜決定と誤認したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: They said they'd check the same doctor's availability and call back. I thought next Tuesday had been decided.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistook Tuesday for a confirmed date even though you are awaiting a callback about the same doctor's availability. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 折り返し前なら、候補と確定を分けて確認しましょう。現在の予約票はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: If they haven't called back yet, let's distinguish a proposed date from a confirmed one. Do you have your current appointment slip?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 持っています。元の予約を自分で消さず、変更が成立したかを先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 元予約票を保持し自分で取り消さず変更成立確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have it. I won't cancel the original appointment myself; I'd like to ask first whether the change has gone through.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have kept the original appointment slip, won't cancel it yourself, and want to check whether the change has been finalized. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へ確認します。勤務先にはまだ送っていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check with the person in charge. You haven't sent it to your workplace yet, have you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。確認できるまでは、変更希望を出して返事を待っていると伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 勤務先未送信で変更希望返事待ちと伝える予定を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. Until it's confirmed, I'll tell them I've requested a change and am waiting for a response.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you haven't sent it to your workplace yet and plan to tell them your change request is awaiting a response. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 日時が決まったら新しい案内を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: When the date and time are decided, please check the new instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確定した日時を確認してから勤務先へ送ります。候補だけで元の予約がなくなったとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 日時確定後報告し候補だけで元予約消滅とみなさないと復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll confirm the finalized date and time before sending them to my workplace. I won't assume the original appointment is gone just because there's a proposed date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will report the date and time after confirmation and won't consider the original appointment canceled based on a proposed date alone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。予約担当へおつなぎします。少々お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05209-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll connect you to the appointment desk. Please wait a moment.
